name: encode an integer as a self-delimiting bit pattern
mechanism: write an integer as a fixed pattern that the decoder can end without a length field -- a run of ones ending in zero, a length prefix followed by the value's bits, or a quotient in unary and a remainder in binary -- so small integers cost few bits
